From 5a1da42b50f3594e18738885c2f23ed36629dd00 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ankit Nautiyal <ankit.k.nautiyal@intel.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2024 11:14:43 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/dp: Fix the computation for compressed_bpp for
 DISPLAY < 13

For DISPLAY < 13, compressed bpp is chosen from a list of
supported compressed bpps. Fix the condition to choose the
appropriate compressed bpp from the list.

Fixes: 1c56e9a39833 ("drm/i915/dp: Get optimal link config to have best compressed bpp")
Cc: Ankit Nautiyal <ankit.k.nautiyal@intel.com>
Cc: Stanislav Lisovskiy <stanislav.lisovskiy@intel.com>
Cc: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@linux.intel.com>
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v6.7+
Closes: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/drm/intel/-/issues/10162
Signed-off-by: Ankit Nautiyal <ankit.k.nautiyal@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240305054443.2489895-1-ankit.k.nautiyal@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
index 7192f2be3aaf..6a67eb379292 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
@@ -1913,8 +1913,9 @@ icl_dsc_compute_link_config(struct intel_dp *intel_dp,
 	dsc_max_bpp = min(dsc_max_bpp, pipe_bpp - 1);
 
 	for (i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(valid_dsc_bpp); i++) {
-		if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] < dsc_min_bpp ||
-		    valid_dsc_bpp[i] > dsc_max_bpp)
+		if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] < dsc_min_bpp)
+			continue;
+		if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] > dsc_max_bpp)
 			break;
 
 		ret = dsc_compute_link_config(intel_dp,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c`**
- The patch modifies the logic within the `icl_dsc_compute_link_config` function.
- The original condition that checked if `valid_dsc_bpp[i]` was less than `dsc_min_bpp` and greater than `dsc_max_bpp` has been changed.
- The new logic first checks if `valid_dsc_bpp[i]` is less than `dsc_min_bpp` and continues to the next iteration if true.
- The check for `valid_dsc_bpp[i]` being greater than `dsc_max_bpp` remains, but is now separated into its own condition.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to the computation of `compressed_bpp` for DISPLAY versions less than 13, as indicated in the commit message.
- The change is a fix for a previous commit (1c56e9a39833) that aimed to optimize link configuration for compressed bpp, suggesting that the earlier implementation had a flaw in handling the range of valid compressed bpp values.
- The patch is linked to an issue reported on GitLab, indicating that it resolves a specific problem encountered by users.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915/dp: Fix the computation for compressed_bpp for
 DISPLAY < 13

For DISPLAY < 13, compressed bpp is chosen from a list of
supported compressed bpps. Fix the condition to choose the
appropriate compressed bpp from the list.

Fixes: 1c56e9a39833 ("drm/i915/dp: Get optimal link config to have best compressed bpp")
Cc: Ankit Nautiyal <ankit.k.nautiyal@intel.com>
Cc: Stanislav Lisovskiy <stanislav.lisovskiy@intel.com>
Cc: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@linux.intel.com>
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v6.7+
Closes: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/drm/intel/-/issues/10162

Reviewed-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240305054443.2489895-1-ankit.k.nautiyal@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect condition in the logic that determined the valid range for compressed bits per pixel (bpp). The original implementation did not properly handle cases where the valid compressed bpp was less than the minimum required bpp, leading to potential incorrect selections from the list of supported compressed bpps for DISPLAY versions less than 13.

Here is the patch:
  */
 static int
 icl_dsc_compute_link_config(struct intel_dp *intel_dp,
 			    struct intel_crtc_state *pipe_config,
 			    struct link_config_limits *limits,
 			    int dsc_max_bpp,
 			    int dsc_min_bpp,
 			    int pipe_bpp,
 			    int timeslots)
 {
 	int i, ret;
 
 	/* Compressed BPP should be less than the Input DSC bpp */
 	dsc_max_bpp = min(dsc_max_bpp, pipe_bpp - 1);
 
 	for (i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(valid_dsc_bpp); i++) {
-		if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] < dsc_min_bpp ||
-		    valid_dsc_bpp[i] > dsc_max_bpp)
+		if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] < dsc_min_bpp)
+			continue;
+		if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] > dsc_max_bpp)
 			break;
 
 		ret = dsc_compute_link_config(intel_dp,
 					      pipe_config,
 					      limits,
 					      valid_dsc_bpp[i] << 4,
 					      timeslots);
 		if (ret == 0) {
 			pipe_config->dsc.compressed_bpp_x16 =
 				to_bpp_x16(valid_dsc_bpp[i]);
 			return 0;
 		}
 	}
 
 	return -EINVAL;
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] < dsc_min_bpp ||
    valid_dsc_bpp[i] > dsc_max_bpp)
```
Reason:
This condition incorrectly checks both the minimum and maximum bounds for valid compressed bpp in a single statement. If the valid compressed bpp is less than `dsc_min_bpp`, it fails to consider the case where it might still be a valid option if it is within the acceptable range for DISPLAY versions less than 13. This leads to potential incorrect selections from the list of supported compressed bpps.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] < dsc_min_bpp)
    continue;
if (valid_dsc_bpp[i] > dsc_max_bpp)
    break;
```
Reason:
The fix separates the conditions for checking the valid compressed bpp. By using `continue` for the minimum check, it allows the loop to skip invalid values without breaking the iteration prematurely. This ensures that all valid compressed bpp options are considered, particularly for DISPLAY versions less than 13, thus correcting the selection logic.
